interface.longDescription: Lintel is a company-neutral, pack-driven session harness for agent-based development. 8-phase cycle (SENSE→DEFINE→DISCOVER→PLAN→BUILD→REVIEW→SHIP→CAPTURE). Role-lifting for persona context. Context-warming for 1M-window utilization. Pack-driven compliance gates, voice calibration, doc-gen for PPT/Word/Web, and repo scaffolding for new engagements. Company identity (voice, compliance, persona, brand) is resolved from the active pack, not hardcoded. Multi-CLI: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, OpenCode, Copilot CLI, Factory Droid.
